name: Gufo
description: Gufo is an open source local inference engine built and tuned for AMD Strix Halo (Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, Radeon 8060S gfx1151). It serves Qwen3.8, DeepSeek V4 Flash, speech, embedding, image and video models through an OpenAI-compatible API, with speculative decoding, concurrent requests and prompt caching. The script installs the official release build through Nix, using prebuilt ROCm from the Gufo binary cache.

notes.text: Gufo targets AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) only. The container needs /dev/kfd and /dev/dri passed through, which the script sets up when GPU passthrough is enabled.
The install runs the official Nix installer from nixos.org and asks before it does. Set var_external_installer=yes for unattended installs.
The first start downloads Qwen3.8 27B Q4_K_XL (about 17 GB). Follow it with: journalctl -fu gufo
The API listens on all interfaces with no API key. To require one, add --api-key <key> to GUFO_SERVER_ARGS in /opt/gufo/gufo.env.
Change the model or server options in /opt/gufo/gufo.env, then run: systemctl restart gufo
Check the GPU from inside the container with: gufo diagnose
If a release is not in the Gufo binary cache yet, installing or updating compiles it locally and takes much longer.
